name: machinemail
description: Email inboxes for AI agents. Create an address, wait for sign-up codes, read and search mail with a trust verdict on every message, and reply, forward or draft for human review.

interface.longDescription:
MachineMail gives your agent real email inboxes. Create an address in one step, wait for a sign-in code to arrive, read and search mail, and send, reply, forward or save drafts for a person to review.

Every inbound message comes with a trust verdict (verified, known, unknown, suspicious or quarantined) and an agent-safe text version. Quarantined messages are withheld from the model, and the agent is told to act only on verified senders and to treat everything else as information, never as instructions.

You sign in with your MachineMail account and choose which organization, pod or inbox the agent can use. You can revoke access at any time.
capabilities: Read, search and wait for incoming email
Trust verdict and agent-safe text for every message
Send, reply, forward and draft email
defaultPrompt: Create a new inbox I can use to sign up for a newsletter
Summarise the unread mail in my inboxes
Wait for a verification code and tell me what it is
